eco.title: The Fly Infinity Ecosystem
eco.subtitle: Four interconnected pillars. One community-driven vision.
eco.networkText: The development layer that connects participants, activity and the wider platform.
eco.fitText: A DAI-reserve-backed token model with an on-chain price calculated from reserve and supply.
eco.giftText: A dedicated ecosystem component designed for community gifting and distribution features.
eco.daoText: The governance component for proposals and networker voting, according to the deployed contract rules.
eco.reserveTitle: How the FIT price is calculated
eco.reserveText: The displayed on-chain price is calculated as the DAI reserve held by the FIT token contract divided by the current FIT total supply. This is a contract formula, not a promise of future market value or guaranteed returns.
eco.flowText: Network, FIT, Gift and DAO are presented as connected parts of the Fly Infinity platform. Each component has a distinct role while contributing to the wider ecosystem.
eco.note: Information describes the platform design and currently deployed contract logic. It is not financial advice or a guarantee of price performance.
